scope: Disposable loopback preview with synthetic cookie identity. Live local recovery and CSRF; intercepted responses for UI state scenarios. No live SSO or production data.

checks.name: live preview renders 27 exact operations and responsive overview
status filter, Persian number search and empty search state
recovery form requires review reason and antiforgery rejects missing token
real recovery changes one pending operation once and refreshes dashboard
lost response after server commit preserves request across refresh and retries idempotently
known pending receipt requires deliberate new request identity
incomplete or corrupt report disables recovery and explains evidence limits
failed refresh keeps last report visible but disables a new recovery
large wire decimals remain exact on mobile and drawer stays within viewport
empty report and failed read have clear distinct states
malformed and foreign reports are rejected without rendering injected text
page reports no uncaught JavaScript errors
